cohort_total_n_excerpt: Among the 498 male participants with measured plasma vitamin C levels, 62 men were subsequently diagnosed with prostate cancer during their lifetime.
reason: The study prospectively analyzed subsequent diagnoses of prostate cancer overall. No aggressive prostate cancer incidence endpoint is established in the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The age-adjusted relative risk of prostate cancer for the highest quartile (median = 1.47 mg/dL, range = 1.36-2.58) compared with the lowest quartile (median = 0.83 mg/dL, range = 0.15-0.98) of plasma vitamin C concentration was 1.31 (95% confidence interval 0.63 to 2.70, P for trend = 0.29).
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported estimate is for prostate cancer overall, without an aggressive subtype restriction.
